QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] A Time to Celebrate
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: The long-cherished desire of the Nova was finally fulfilled. Magnus was driven out of Heliseum. The residents can't return yet, as the city hasn't been fully secured, but in time they will come home.
QuestInfo.2: The long-cherished desire of the Nova was finally fulfilled. Magnus was driven out of Heliseum. The residents can't return as the city hasn't been secured yet, but they will regain their place.
